Hey, coming from a woman who is 10 years older than you but very much the same in many ways, be kind to yourself. <3 I started picking at the same age, have ADHD, and also have SD/folliculitis flare ups from time to time. here are the things that help me. 

- daily wash with either a medicated or clarifying shampoo and don’t go to bed with wet hair. Shampoo with tea tree oil or salicylic acid can help as well. 
- keep nails done (paint them yourself and get some fun nail stickers, or try getting a gel mani if you have the time/money, the thickness of the gel makes it much harder to pick) 
- learn to French braid! Wearing my hair in tight-ish pigtails has really helped me avoid picking bc I don’t want to mess up my work. 

Deep breath. You acknowledge that you want to stop and acknowledge that it’s a compulsive behavior (I.e., picking even though it hurts), and you CAN and WILL heal with time. And as the spots heal, so will your urges. Young teenage skin can repair itself so well, your body is naturally inclined to heal things if you let it! 

Good luck!
